RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
The frozen detector uses a DASHED grey border plus a small [Fixed] pill; NO padlock symbol.
In the window grid, selected windows are marked by DIAGONAL HATCHING, not by fill colour, so the figure survives greyscale printing.
The floating note about predicted-unchanged windows must be clearly attached to the window grid.
Amber (#E69F00) is used for residual-error block borders only, never as text colour.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 8-9pt, notes 7-8pt.
Icons are monochrome thin grey line art. No colored icons.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no drop shadows.
